correctness.rationale: The no-universal weight-four lemma reduces total Roman bondage to destruction of all adjacent dominating edges. Five-edge and four-edge explicit patterns give upper bounds; every admissible small deletion is exhaustively checked for m=2,3,4 (299/2517/6196 cases), and any at-most-four-deletion counterexample on m>4 restricts to an isolate-free four-C-vertex subgraph without altering domination of untouched C vertices. The exceptional universal-vertex m=1 case is checked. Standalone exhaustive code is included and replayed; finite tests alone are not claimed to imply infinitely many instances.
